top_signals.title: Treasury Two-Year Yields Sink Most Since 2025 as AI Worries Bite
top_signals.summary: Short-dated US Treasuries were set for their best week in more than a year as global stocks slumped on mounting doubts over the artificial intelligence trade.

top_signals.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
top_signals.summary: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
